messages:
jess_fin: FYI BlueMesa Labs sent INV-50177 for $8,910 referencing PO-812 and PO-813. AP auto-flagged AMOUNT_MISMATCH. Vendor says they applied an early-pay discount but the POs show full amounts. Need routing.

tonY_ap: @jess_fin attach invoice + remittance pls. AP log shows split lines but totals don't reconcile to either PO.

jess_fin: attached PDF + vendor e-mail. Vendor applied 2% early-pay discount across invoice; they say we approved discount during negotiation but i can't find PO note.

ap-system: MATCH_FAIL: reason=AMOUNT_MISMATCH; candidates=[PO-812:9000, PO-813:1500]; invoice_lines: [services:7200, license:1800, discount:-90]; invoice_total=8910.

mia_proc: Procurement records: PO-812 was for $9,000 (services) and PO-813 $1,500 (licenses). No authorized discount recorded. We need confirmation from the buyer or a PO change.

leo_fpna: If discount was approved, GL allocation unchanged. If not, we need vendor to reissue or we do a manual variance hold and confirm approval. For payrun Wednesday, prefer vendor reissue.

jess_fin: tried calling vendor; vendor rep says account exec verbal okayed 2% on 2024-10-28 but no written amendment. They offered to reissue with original amounts and a separate credit memo for the discount.

mia_proc: that's acceptable. Request vendor reissue invoice + credit memo or a PO change. Opening PR ticket.

procure-bot: Ticket PR-4628 created: "BlueMesa INV-50177 amount mismatch / early-pay discount - request reissue" assigned to procurement-queue.

ap-system: Invoice INV-50177 moved to "Pending Vendor Action". Hold timer=48h. Attach reissued invoice or credit memo to PR-4628 to clear match.

leo_fpna: provisional action: if vendor can't reissue by EOD tomorrow, hold payment and escalate to account owner for written confirmation. Approver for variance: leo_fpna.

jess_fin: i'll push vendor for reissue and ask account exec for written confirmation. tagging @mia_proc to escalate if no response. :pray:

mia_proc: will follow up with account owner and update PR-4628.

ap-system: Reminder: payrun cutoff in 36h. Current invoice status=on-hold.
